Pilot describes object over Coral Ridge

Harbour Dispatch — 14 March 2026

A commercial pilot has described an object that paced her aircraft for roughly four minutes on the evening of 2 March, north-east of Coral Ridge.

"It held station off the right wing, then left on a vector we could not match," said Captain R. Alvarado, who reported the sighting to her operator the same night.

The operator confirmed that an internal safety report was filed. No radar correlation has been released.
